results.description:
Tennis Score Wizard is a focused Apple Watch score tracker for real tennis matches.

Launch Tennis Score Wizard instantly from your Apple Watch face using the included complication, then track every point directly from your wrist.

Track points, games, sets, tie-breaks, server order, serve position, match length, workout time, live heart rate, automatic match statistics, and complete match history without interrupting play.

Choose singles or doubles, Best of 3 or Best of 5, and play with or without a tie-break at 6–6.

After every match, open History to review detailed statistics generated automatically from your normal scoring taps. No additional input is required.

Match statistics include:
• Total points played
• Points won by each side
• Service games and service points
• Return games and return points
• Break points saved and converted
• Tie-breaks won and lost
• Longest game
• Average points per game
• Total games played

With optional Apple Health integration, you can record tennis matches as workouts. When permission is granted, Tennis Score Wizard displays your live heart rate during play and automatically saves the workout to Apple Health and the Fitness app.

Recorded workouts also include:
• Average heart rate
• Maximum heart rate
• Active calories

Designed for real tennis matches, Tennis Score Wizard features large tappable score controls, responsive haptic feedback, undo support, automatic server switching, serve position guidance, automatic match completion, and quick access from your Apple Watch face through the built-in complication.

Features:
• Apple Watch complication for instant one-tap launch
• Singles and doubles match setup
• Best of 3 and Best of 5 match formats
• Advantage sets or tie-break sets
• Tie-break scoring to 7, win by 2
• First server selection with animated coin toss
• Automatic match statistics
• Serve, return, pressure, and game flow analysis
• Apple Health workout integration
• Live heart rate during recorded matches
• Workout statistics in match history
• Switch server during an active match
• Compact serve position indicator
• Large Apple Watch scoring interface
• Undo last point
• Match history
• Local-only match data storage

Whether you're playing a friendly match, training session, or tournament, Tennis Score Wizard keeps tennis scoring fast, accurate, and always available on your wrist.
